description: This file is a PHP template that processes investment data, calculates financial metrics including totals, fees, VAT, and commissions, and generates an HTML table report summarizing these figures. It references variables passed into the template and calls external functions for formatting amounts.

methods.name: countTotal
methods.description: Counts the total number of investments with a specific method and a status >= 1.

methods.name: calcTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total amount of investments with a specific method and a status >= 1.
